Hi All,

Please see below for junior and senior job calls from the College of Connected Computing (CCC)<

> at Vanderbilt University.

The CCC comprises multiple interconnected Areas, one of which is Computing + Society<

> (C+S). C+S centers social and humanist perspectives to study computing as a social product and social force. We are very much hoping to build out the C+S Area. Please consider joining us!

When applying for the C+S Area you should specify Humans, Computing & Society as your stream for review.

Please be in touch with any questions about C+S or the CCC more broadly.
